purpose: Suggest an uncertain cause for a usually negative observation.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
Plain clause / Nの / な-adjectiveな + せいか
Perhaps because I have not slept enough, my head feels heavy.
Perhaps because of the rain, there are few customers.
Perhaps because we had not met for a long time, I felt a little nervous.
formation: Plain clause / Nの / な-adjectiveな + せいか
restrictions: か makes the causal attribution tentative; often negative but not always.
mistake: Do not present a guessed cause as established fact.
